problem: The complete designation is absent from the active glossary; its components are not an established English assignment.
working_treatment: Proposed whole-expression rendering: “Buddhists.” The title formula ཞེས་བྱ་བ་བཞུགས་སོ is represented by presenting the title.
uncertainty: The religious designation is clear; terminology approval remains open.
review_action: Review the proposed whole-expression entry; retain mental faculty and going for refuge unchanged.

problem: The threefold refuge designation has no whole-expression entry. The four homage lines supply the guru as the shared addressee.
working_treatment: “Three supreme ones” is Proposed; “you” links the three preceding attributes to the guru in entry 5.
uncertainty: The reference to the Three Jewels is likely; the Tibetan designation is kept distinct in English.
review_action: Approve or revise this exact designation without replacing the source term.

problem: This technical threefold expression is absent from the glossary.
working_treatment: Proposed: “three roots”; the text does not enumerate them here.
uncertainty: No added enumeration is assumed.
review_action: Review the proposed technical entry.

problem: The phrase contrasts with outer and inner going for refuge; “ultimate refuge” would add a specificity not explicitly present.
working_treatment: Proposed construction: “going for refuge in its meaning,” retaining the established meaning assignment for དོན་.
uncertainty: “Actual going for refuge” is a possible contextual alternative; the precise force of the genitive needs review.
review_action: Review the threefold classification and approve the construction.

problem: No standalone བླ་མ་ entry exists; the established Guru Yoga expression does not establish every occurrence.
working_treatment: Proposed: “guru,” including subsequent occurrences.
uncertainty: No substantive semantic doubt here; terminology approval remains open.
review_action: Review the new standalone entry.

problem: The final form ཞུན is unusual in this explanatory sentence and may be a transcription defect.
working_treatment: The sentence is provisionally rendered “is explained”; the exact source is unchanged.
uncertainty: A form of ཞུ or another reporting verb may have been intended, but no emendation is adopted.
review_action: Check this reading against an authenticated source.

problem: Here དོན names divisions of an exposition rather than lexical meaning.
working_treatment: Proposed scoped rendering: “four topics”; entry 7 uses “the first topic.”
uncertainty: This does not replace the established meaning assignment in other constructions.
review_action: Review this expository whole-expression use.

problem: Standalone ཆོས་ is not assigned in the glossary; its doctrinal compounds do not settle all senses.
working_treatment: Proposed: “Dharma” for the teaching/practice in this section; wholesome and virtuous Dharma retain the source modifiers.
uncertainty: “All teachings” is also possible here; this remains a scoped proposal.
review_action: Review the Dharma usage and its scope across entries 7–35.

problem: Faith is established, but these three complete names are not. In particular, ཡིད་ཆེས་ is a compound, not an occurrence of mental faculty alone.
working_treatment: Proposed: “lucid faith,” “aspiring faith,” and “trusting faith,” retaining faith throughout.
uncertainty: The definitions in entries 10–16 support these choices; approval of the whole expressions is pending.
review_action: Approve or revise the three whole-expression entries and their subsequent occurrences.

problem: Embodiment is established for སྐུ་; standalone གསུང་ and ཐུགས་ and the complete supports expression are absent.
working_treatment: Proposed: “supports of ... embodiment, speech, and awakened mind.” “Awakened mind” renders the honorific ཐུགས་ only in this triad.
uncertainty: This does not equate ཐུགས་ with ordinary mind or establish it universally.
review_action: Review the complete expression and the scoped awakened-mind proposal.

problem: The source has repeated tsheg between qualities and accounts of liberation. No missing word can be established from that marking.
working_treatment: The two nouns are coordinated in English; no omitted Tibetan wording is reconstructed. “Accounts of liberation” for རྣམ་ཐར་ is Proposed.
uncertainty: The punctuation may be merely typographic; whether it signals an omission remains unverified.
review_action: Compare a source witness for the punctuation and review the technical rendering of རྣམ་ཐར་.

problem: The source has སྡུག་བསྔོལ rather than the usual སྡུག་བསྔལ. The relation of samsara and the lower rebirths is compressed.
working_treatment: Provisionally “the suffering” of “samsara and the lower rebirths”; source characters remain unchanged. “Samsara” and “lower rebirths” are Proposed glossary additions.
uncertainty: Likely spelling defect; “samsara, especially the lower rebirths” is possible but would supply the emphasis.
review_action: Verify the source spelling and review the phrase’s coordination.

problem: The source reads མི་དད, literally susceptible to “not believing,” where the sequence of gods, humans, and liberation calls for a link.
working_treatment: Provisional English reads humans AND liberation, treating དད as a suspected དང error; no Tibetan emendation is made.
uncertainty: The defect is suspected, not authenticated. The rough reference’s negation does not fit the surrounding list.
review_action: Check མི་དད against a source witness; approve or reject the proposed reading.

problem: The paired realm term is absent from the glossary.
working_treatment: Proposed: “higher realms”; ཐར་པ in this sentence is proposed as “liberation.”
uncertainty: These do not alter established related compounds such as primordial liberation.
review_action: Review both new technical entries.

problem: The complete refuge designation is absent from the glossary. རྣམ་པ་གསུམ here counts the members rather than clearly asserting three metaphysical aspects.
working_treatment: Proposed whole-expression “Three Precious Jewels”; the shortened expression is “Three Jewels.”
uncertainty: This contextual construction does not change the standalone aspect mapping.
review_action: Review the two designations and the counting construction.

problem: The pairing literally gives “ill or born”; the second member is unexpected in a series of contrasts.
working_treatment: Retained “ill or born,” without substituting “well.”
uncertainty: A transcription defect is possible; the intended contrast cannot be settled here.
review_action: Check སྐྱེ against a witness.

problem: The imperative invocation gives no explicit object for མཁྱེན.
working_treatment: “Heed me!” supplies the speaker as the object in the devotional address.
uncertainty: “You know!” would preserve the objectless form more literally.
review_action: Review the invocation’s preferred grammatical realization.

problem: These linked expressions describe entrusting oneself; only conceptual mind is directly established.
working_treatment: “Direct my conceptual mind, place my hopes, or put my trust” is a Proposed grammatical/whole-expression treatment.
uncertainty: The specific object is inferred from the Three Jewels in entry 15.
review_action: Review the three expressions together, preserving conceptual mind.

problem: The repeated tsheg and construction ཡིད་ཁྱེད་ཤེས are unusual; the latter recurs without extra tsheg in entry 74. The rough reference hides the actual wording.
working_treatment: Proposed: “the mental faculty’s faith that says, ‘You know’,” treating ཁྱེད་ཤེས as devotional entrustment.
uncertainty: The exact attachment of mental faculty and the devotional utterance is unresolved; it is not silently changed to ཡིད་ཆེས.
review_action: Verify the source and review the construction jointly with entry 74.

problem: The literal “white Dharma” denotes a wholesome category in the seed analogy; this whole expression is absent from the glossary.
working_treatment: Proposed: “wholesome Dharma,” also in entry 24.
uncertainty: Literal “white Dharma” remains possible if the project prefers explicit color terminology.
review_action: Review this scoped whole-expression proposal.

problem: This doctrinal expression is absent from the active glossary.
working_treatment: Proposed: “seven riches of noble ones”; no list is supplied by the source here.
uncertainty: The number is explicit; no unseen enumeration is assumed.
review_action: Review the complete technical expression.

problem: The source has standalone ཐུགས, whereas entries 31–32 pair blessings with ཐུགས་རྗེ. The missing རྗེ is not verified.
working_treatment: Provisionally “blessings and compassionate responsiveness,” following the immediate parallel; no source text is altered.
uncertainty: Standalone “awakened mind” is grammatically possible but breaks the nearby parallel.
review_action: Check for omission of རྗེ in an authenticated witness.

problem: The source spelling is not the expected སྐྱེས་པ in this rebirth statement.
working_treatment: Provisionally “was born,” preserving the source spelling in the source artifact.
uncertainty: Likely transcription defect; not independently verified.
review_action: Check the verb against a source witness.

problem: This Buddha epithet and the related recurrent Buddha and hungry-ghost designations lack active glossary assignments.
working_treatment: Proposed: “Blessed One,” “Buddha/buddhahood,” and “hungry ghost”; none changes established compound entries.
uncertainty: These working equivalents require project approval.
review_action: Review the three proposed designations.

problem: The verb རླུག is uncertain in the description of an animal’s entrails.
working_treatment: Provisionally “an animal’s entrails spill out,” without adding a slaughterer or deliberate pulling.
uncertainty: “Fall out” or a source spelling defect is possible; the event’s exact mechanics remain unresolved.
review_action: Verify the verb and its syntax against a witness.

problem: This word has no active entry and must remain distinct from established compassionate responsiveness for ཐུགས་རྗེ.
working_treatment: Proposed: “compassion.”
uncertainty: The distinction in English is intentional; the project has not approved the new entry.
review_action: Review the separate compassion entry.

problem: The compound ཡིད་བྱེད and standalone མོས་པ are absent; confident devotion is established only for མོས་གུས.
working_treatment: Proposed: “attends with the mental faculty in devotion.”
uncertainty: The construction may mean directing attention devotionally; it is not a new canonical counterpart for མོས་གུས.
review_action: Review the two expressions and their syntax.

problem: The glossary has four empowerments but no standalone entry for this verbal expression.
working_treatment: Proposed: “grant empowerment”; the Sage from entry 39 remains the agent of granting and blessing.
uncertainty: No recipient change is assumed.
review_action: Review the verbal entry and preserve the agent across the quotation.

problem: The source has གྲོང rather than an expected honorific death form such as གྲོངས.
working_treatment: Provisionally “passing away,” without changing the Tibetan.
uncertainty: A spelling defect is likely but unverified.
review_action: Check the final consonant in an authenticated witness.

problem: The proverb uses སངས་རྒྱས predicatively; it has no verb meaning “see.”
working_treatment: “An old woman became a Buddha through a dog’s tooth” renders the predicate; Buddha/buddhahood is Proposed terminology.
uncertainty: The proverb’s claim is left as the source’s statement and is not reduced to seeing a Buddha.
review_action: Review the predicative rendering against the original wording.

problem: The timing is slightly awkward with the later statement that he brought the tooth to his mother.
working_treatment: “On reaching the house” preserves the supplied arrival phrase without changing it to “near the house.”
uncertainty: An approach-to-home reading is possible; the exact setting is not specified.
review_action: Review the temporal construction if an earlier source becomes available.

problem: The supplied spelling differs from ལྕེབས in the mother’s threat at entry 55.
working_treatment: Provisionally “kill herself”; no means of suicide is supplied.
uncertainty: Likely spelling defect, supported by the repeated narrative phrase but not source-verified.
review_action: Check this spelling against a witness.

problem: The technical relic term has no active glossary entry.
working_treatment: Proposed: “relics,” without adding a material description.
uncertainty: “Relic pills” would be more specific but is not required by this passage.
review_action: Review the new technical entry.

problem: The complete technical expression is absent; it should not be decomposed into a literal “truth of supreme meaning” without review.
working_treatment: Proposed: “ultimate truth”; the shorter དོན་དམ་པ in entry 68 is “the ultimate.”
uncertainty: This is a proposed whole expression, not a replacement for standalone meaning.
review_action: Review the complete entry and its shorter use.

problem: The dependency construction normally has རག་ལས; the source includes an extra final ས.
working_treatment: Provisionally “depends on,” without changing the source.
uncertainty: Likely spelling defect.
review_action: Verify the supplied spelling against a witness.

problem: The unit ends in གཅིག without an explicit finite predicate, then continues with irreversible extraordinary faith in entry 70.
working_treatment: The English links the entries with an em dash and treats the following faith phrase as specifying the arising trust.
uncertainty: The intended boundary and force of གཅིག remain uncertain; no missing Tibetan is reconstructed.
review_action: Review entries 69–70 together and verify the transition.

problem: The dative ལ marks Mila as the recipient of the question; the rough reference reverses the participants. The spelling of the Dakpo designation is also unusual.
working_treatment: The Precious One of Dakpo asks Mila. The answer in entries 72–73 is assigned to Mila, with “you” referring to the questioner.
uncertainty: The names are recognized provisionally; the agency is supported by the source syntax.
review_action: Check the Dakpo designation against a witness; preserve the dative relation in review.

problem: The wording has ལྷག་གིས་མཐོང, not the established compound ལྷག་མཐོང for special insight.
working_treatment: “See the essence of ordinary mind with a clarity unlike what you have now” keeps the adverbial sense; it does not insert special insight.
uncertainty: The precise adverbial nuance of ལྷག་གིས deserves source review.
review_action: Verify the spelling and adverbial construction.

problem: This repeats the devotional construction of entry 18 and modifies conceptual mind.
working_treatment: Proposed: “a conceptual mind ... the mental faculty saying, ‘You know’.”
uncertainty: The rendering preserves both protected terms but the idiom’s attachment is provisional.
review_action: Review jointly with N-018; do not silently replace with trusting faith.

problem: The three classes of person are not active whole-expression entries.
working_treatment: Proposed: “person of lesser capacity,” “person of middling capacity,” and “person of great capacity.” The word capacity is an interpretive complement in this classification.
uncertainty: More literal small/middling/great person is possible; the proposal is restricted to the path classification.
review_action: Review all three names together, including entries 79, 81–82, and 86.

problem: This verbal expression means pursuing an aim; mechanical substitution of standalone meaning would obscure its syntax.
working_treatment: Proposed whole-expression realization: “seek,” also in entries 79 and 84.
uncertainty: The proposal is restricted to this construction; meaning remains canonical for standalone དོན་.
review_action: Review the scoped verbal expression.

problem: The nirvana expression, abbreviated here, has no active glossary entry.
working_treatment: Proposed: “peaceful state of nirvana,” also using nirvana for the full expression in entry 85.
uncertainty: The abbreviation is interpreted conventionally; no source repair is made.
review_action: Review the entry and attest both forms.

problem: The complete expression is absent; it must not be mechanically rendered as “ordinary-mind possessors.”
working_treatment: Proposed whole-expression: “sentient beings.”
uncertainty: This preserves ordinary mind for standalone སེམས་ while recognizing a distinct compound.
review_action: Review the whole-expression entry.

problem: The source has བླ་མ་མེད་པ, literally “without a guru,” in the standard description of perfect buddhahood, where བླ་ན་མེད་པ is expected.
working_treatment: Provisionally “unsurpassed”; the suspected མ/ན error remains unchanged in Tibetan. Omniscient for རྣམ་མཁྱེན is also a Proposed technical assignment.
uncertainty: The intended phrase is strongly suggested by context but unverified.
review_action: Check the exact syllable against an authenticated source.

problem: In the appearance-versus-reality contrast this construction functions adverbially; the standalone glossary meaning cannot be inserted mechanically.
working_treatment: Proposed contextual construction: “in actuality.”
uncertainty: This is restricted to this construction and is not a new default for དོན་.
review_action: Review this scoped exception.

problem: Neither complete vehicle/person designation is assigned. The substring རང་སངས is not the standalone self-purified occurrence.
working_treatment: Proposed: “śrāvaka” and “pratyekabuddha,” retaining the complete technical terms.
uncertainty: These transliterations do not approve new defaults for their components.
review_action: Review both whole-expression entries.

problem: Here དོན concerns acting for beings’ sake; it is not lexical meaning.
working_treatment: Proposed: “fail to act for the sake of the sentient beings.”
uncertainty: This benefit/purpose use is restricted to the quoted construction.
review_action: Review this contextual use separately from the standalone meaning assignment.

problem: This recurring technical term has no active glossary entry.
working_treatment: Proposed: “merit.”
uncertainty: No distinction beyond the source’s immeasurable merit is added.
review_action: Review the standalone technical entry.

problem: The list promises ten aspects (entry 91), but the final two lack a separating shad and སྐྱབ lacks the final ས of the usual སྐྱབས.
working_treatment: Read the last span as two items, “ultimate object of refuge” and “manner of cultivation,” without changing the source.
uncertainty: Supported by the later separate discussions at entries 150 and 159; source spelling remains unverified.
review_action: Check against an authoritative textual witness; retain the original transcript separately.

problem: The complete technical expression is absent from the glossary; its component གཞི must not force the unrelated technical assignment “The Ground.”
working_treatment: Propose “instances”: the following Buddha, Dharma, and Sangha are the instances identified.
uncertainty: “Examples” or “bases of definition” are possible; no equivalent is approved.
review_action: Approve or revise the whole-expression equivalent; compare མཚན་ཉིད at entry 97.

problem: The transcript reads རྟོག (conceptualizing), whereas the expected abandonment-and-realization expression has རྟོགས. The human reference also takes realization, but is not textual proof.
working_treatment: Render “abandonment and realization” provisionally; preserve སྤང་རྟོག in the source.
uncertainty: A likely missing final ས, not an authenticated correction.
review_action: Collate the phrase before approving a source correction or an unqualified translation.

problem: The glossary assigns standalone དོན “meaning”; here the two concern the benefit or aims of oneself and others, not two semantic meanings.
working_treatment: Propose the whole-expression rendering “the two aims: one’s own and others’.”
uncertainty: “Benefits” or “welfare” could express the contextual sense; no exception is approved.
review_action: Review this construction and linked དོན་གཉིས occurrences at 98 and 103.

problem: The compound རིག་གྲོལ is absent from the glossary; རིག་ is abbreviated relative to established རིག་པ “awareness.”
working_treatment: Propose “possesses awareness and liberation,” retaining the established awareness vocabulary.
uncertainty: The scope of རིག in this Sangha definition may be knowledge rather than the technical awareness sense.
review_action: Approve the compound or a scoped alternative after reviewing entries 96 and 111.

problem: The technical definition/defining-characteristic expression has no glossary row.
working_treatment: Propose “defining characteristics” for the heading and its subsequent eightfold sets.
uncertainty: A contextual rendering, not an approved glossary addition.
review_action: Review alongside མཚན་གཞི; approve a technical entry if suitable.

problem: The attachment of “ultimate” within this compact series is not explicitly marked. The two purities are not named here.
working_treatment: Retain “possesses the two purities, is ultimate” without supplying their conventional names.
uncertainty: “Ultimate in possessing the two purities” is another attachment.
review_action: Confirm the construction in a witness or commentary.

problem: The threefold set is absent from the glossary; མཁྱེན is not the established ཤེས་པ knowing or ཡེ་ཤེས primordial knowing.
working_treatment: Propose “knowledge, love, and power,” keeping the three components distinct.
uncertainty: No new glossary defaults are approved by this wording.
review_action: Approve or revise the complete technical set in its Buddha-definition context.

problem: Cessation, uncontaminated, and complete purification are technical expressions absent from the glossary; the passage identifies two truths by its own wording.
working_treatment: Propose literal technical renderings; do not replace the two truths with ultimate and conventional truth.
uncertainty: These local choices are provisional, not glossary-approved definitions.
review_action: Review the technical mappings and the following quoted verse together.

problem: The relative pronouns distinguish that which is freedom from attachment and that by which it is reached. Their referents are left implicit in the verse.
working_treatment: Supply only the English relational syntax; read with cessation and path explicitly named in entry 105.
uncertainty: The division of the six preceding qualities across the two truths needs commentary-level confirmation.
review_action: Review the complete verse, entries 106–109; do not treat the human reference’s inserted labels as source words.

problem: བྱང་སེམས is a whole-expression abbreviation for bodhisattva here, identified with the Victors’ children; no glossary entry covers it.
working_treatment: Propose “bodhisattvas,” rather than expanding the component སེམས as ordinary mind.
uncertainty: This applies to persons, not the separately discussed aspirational bodhicitta.
review_action: Approve or revise the whole-expression mapping and keep the two uses distinct.

problem: The stages denoted by ས are not the glossary headword གཞི, The Ground.
working_treatment: Propose “great stages,” without adding a number not stated in the source.
uncertainty: The technical bodhisattva-stage sense is supported by the named practitioners; the number is not explicit.
review_action: Approve the stage terminology separately from The Ground.

problem: This is the first verse line, following a prose attribution in the same source entry; the human reference places its meaning under the next entry.
working_treatment: Keep the line here and continue its construction through “seeing through primordial knowing” at entry 113.
uncertainty: “Inward” is attached to seeing; the exact scope of the two modes of knowledge should be reviewed.
review_action: Keep the source-order lineation and split prose attribution from verse in paired publication.

problem: The complete expression can designate persons endowed with intelligence; only its component བློ has the established mapping “conceptual mind.”
working_treatment: Retain “those endowed with conceptual mind” provisionally rather than silently substituting “wise.”
uncertainty: The literal construction does not settle the degree or kind of intelligence intended.
review_action: Review whether the whole expression needs a separately approved equivalent.

problem: The transcript has ཁྱེད་པར where the outline at 92 and surrounding discussion support ཁྱད་པར, “distinctions.” Its final connective is also དད rather than expected དང.
working_treatment: Translate the heading as “The distinctions” and the sentence as a four-item list, without changing the Tibetan.
uncertainty: Both are suspected transcription defects.
review_action: Check the original witness for the heading and final connective.

problem: The resultant-refuge construction and arhat are not glossary entries; the clause continues into the Sangha explanation at 121.
working_treatment: Propose “the resultant refuge is an arhat,” not the claim that all śrāvakas are arhats.
uncertainty: The relation between the arhat and the following Sangha definition should be reviewed as a unit.
review_action: Approve the compound terms and confirm the construction across 120–121.

problem: The verb “consider” has an implicit object in a series contrasting the three vehicles’ resultant refuges.
working_treatment: Supply “their refuge” from the topic introduced at 120.
uncertainty: The sentence does not state that dependent arising itself is the practitioner; alternative attachment must preserve the threefold comparison.
review_action: Review entries 120–124 together.

problem: The transcript reads འཇིག་པ, destruction, rather than འཇིགས་པ, fear. The latter occurs explicitly at entry 130.
working_treatment: Retain “frees one from destruction” and do not silently add a final ས.
uncertainty: A missing final ས is possible, but the present reading is intelligible.
review_action: Check the source witness before choosing between destruction and fear.

problem: The verb འཛིན་པ here means regarding or taking something as something; applying the nominal technical glossary assignment “apprehending subject” would misstate the construction.
working_treatment: Propose “regard ... as” in this explicit X-as-Y construction.
uncertainty: This is an occurrence-specific verbal use, not a replacement glossary default.
review_action: Approve the scoped construction for 123–124 and the related use in 131.

problem: The expression is absent from the glossary; the source retains སྙིང་པོ, which the human reference omits.
working_treatment: Propose “the heart of awakening.”
uncertainty: “Awakening, the essence” is another possible attachment.
review_action: Review the whole expression before approving the proposed equivalent.

problem: Standalone སྙིང་རྗེ is absent from the glossary, which separately establishes compassionate responsiveness for ཐུགས་རྗེ.
working_treatment: Use the coordinated proposal “great compassion”; do not conflate the two Tibetan expressions.
uncertainty: Proposed and unapproved.
review_action: Review the whole-work compassion proposal and preserve the distinction.

problem: The transcript has the genitive པའི where the parallel with ཉན་ཐོས་པས suggests the agentive པས.
working_treatment: Render the greater-vehicle practitioner as the agent and “others” as the beneficiaries, provisionally.
uncertainty: Likely particle defect; the source remains unchanged.
review_action: Check the particle in the witness.

problem: The relation expressed by ལ in the first alternative is compressed. The sentence then explicitly supplies a second alternative: accepting Buddha and so forth while seeking a lesser result.
working_treatment: Read the first alternative as taking another deity as teacher in place of Buddha; preserve the two alternatives separately.
uncertainty: Taking another deity “as the perfectly complete Buddha” is a possible literal attachment. The human reference conflates the alternatives.
review_action: Review the first construction against an authoritative witness/commentary.

problem: This complete technical expression is absent from the glossary; mechanically replacing its སེམས component with ordinary mind would obscure the distinction under discussion.
working_treatment: Propose “generating aspirational bodhicitta,” distinguished from the mere wish involved in going for refuge.
uncertainty: The whole-expression mapping is proposed, not an approved exception to ordinary mind.
review_action: Approve a compound entry and link the abbreviated སྨོན་སེམས in 92.

problem: The transcript has ཆད, not the expected purpose expression ཆེད.
working_treatment: Render the differentiation as the stated purpose, while leaving ཆད intact in the source.
uncertainty: Suspected vowel omission; uncollated.
review_action: Verify the word against a witness.

problem: This expression follows a genitive agent, gods and nāgas, in a list of benefits. Literal “spoken for their sake” does not explain the syntax well.
working_treatment: Provisionally read “speak of one with acclaim,” allowing the expression an exclamatory/praising sense.
uncertainty: A defective case marker or a different idiomatic use remains possible.
review_action: Review this exact construction; do not treat the human reference as authority.

problem: ཆོས་མཐུན refers here to properties shared with precious gems, as the preceding དང construction and six following comparisons show; it is not “in accordance with Dharma.”
working_treatment: Render “six properties they share with precious gems,” and retain that relation throughout 144–149.
uncertainty: The specific six properties are supplied by the text itself, not an added doctrinal enumeration.
review_action: Review this repeated relational construction as a single usage.

problem: The sixfold technical expression is absent from the glossary; standalone ཤེས་པ is “knowing.”
working_treatment: Propose “six kinds of higher knowing,” preserving that component without supplying the six names.
uncertainty: No approved whole-expression equivalent is available.
